contract.operation: DesktopController.perform public signature unchanged. One absolute time.monotonic deadline (existing 3-second IPC budget) is created at admission. It covers initial focus, adapter version, mutation socket connect, final focus, drain, response, and bounded wait_closed cleanup. No per-stage budget resets.
contract.deadline_meaning: When supplied, deadline is an absolute time.monotonic timestamp, not a duration. Existing query/action calls with no keyword get a bounded default total 3-second lifetime. FocusValidator forwards the optional deadline without changing standalone caller syntax.
contract.read_worker: Async query timeout covers executor queue admission. _request checks expiry before opening any socket and uses remaining budget for connect/sendall/EACH recv, so trickle bytes cannot reset the total lifetime. A cancelled caller does not claim thread cancellation; an already-started read-only worker ends by its original socket deadline, or a late-start worker refuses before I/O. Queries cannot issue mutation commands.
contract.final_dispatch: Fresh target/app/authorization/lease/cancellation fence is retained. Deadline is synchronously checked after focus and immediately before typed writer.write; no intervening await or mutation worker queue. Deadline expiry denies pre-dispatch even if the event loop timeout callback has not yet run.

new_regressions: Timeout at every async barrier: initial focus, version, connect, final focus, drain, response and wait_closed. Before-dispatch timeout produces no wire mutation. After-dispatch timeout records no successful action or replay, NOT no-mutation proof.
Focus and version share exactly the same absolute deadline; their elapsed times add rather than reset budgets.
Synchronous final validation crossing the deadline still denies before wire write even before timeout cancellation delivery.
Actual disposable Unix socket trickle reads during initial focus and version end their read-only workers by the total deadline, with zero mutation commands.
Actual pending initial-focus/version cancellation + lease release leaves no mutation and observes worker completion; no unhandled async exception contexts.
Actual mutation-response trickle expires within the total deadline and sends at most the original command, never retries.
Standalone query default budget is total, not per receive.
Saturated executor queue uses query admission deadline; a worker with already-expired deadline refuses before opening any socket.
Actual stalled (no bytes) Unix read closes by total socket deadline.
remaining_limits: No realtime/preemptive guarantee for synchronous OS/filesystem/SQLite work; final synchronous expiry fence prevents late dispatch once control returns.
Read-only worker cancellation is not forced termination; its original absolute socket deadline bounds its I/O lifetime.
After a mutation command is written, timeout/cancellation cannot prove compositor non-mutation; no automatic retry/replay was introduced.
The final fence is local wire-write, not compositor-atomic compare-and-mutate. External focus can change after the final query.
Existing socket disconnect alone is not handler cancellation. External cancellation and human consent transport remain parent-owned integration/acceptance work.
Existing owner/harness public activation now fails closed until main integrates the authenticated trusted channel. Do not deploy this partial stack.
